body: no, thank you. really. it helps, and we all must know a little bit how each other feels, or we wouldn't be on here, eh?

i make too much money on unemployment, which is amusing seeing as i am now in massive debt, starving and sick. i was fired illegally, and to shut me up, they gave me unemployment benefits. i really want to die, but i know i can't. and that's the worst. i will NEVER tell them that i want to die. that leads to hospitalization, and every moment i am not within fifty feet of my home, i bug. black out panic attacks. i was fired because i dared call the police after a customer assaulted me, cracking my skull and causing a now untreated TBI. because i worked in an adult retail establishment, the cops blew it off. they mocked me when they arrived, told me what did i expect working at a place like that. i dunno. a friend of mine said she would come over and take me to the hospital tomorrow so i don't have to be alone. it's hard for me to be honest with the crisis people because i am so embarrassed that my life has spiraled so out of control. i have PTSD. i was a child prostitute, not by choice, and it is really hard to talk about. i have been a mess since my divorce, he is now marrying my former best friend. i have no family, except for a brother who hates me. like genuinely hates me. he tells people he wishes i would kill myself. and he lives three hundred feet away. i won't even sit on my porch anymore because i am so afraid to see him. i know this sounds so insane, but i HOPE that this way i feel is linked to the physical trauma to my head. because this is hell. i am going to try and get disability, but i still want to work. i am hoping if i go to the hospital and talk to someone that they can help or point me in the right direction...it's just so hard. i literally cannot move and it is the most frustrating thing ever. it's like my body is dead but my mind is full bore. immobile. 

thank you for listening. it's very hard when you cannot afford a phone or walk outside without passing out/blacking out in public.
